decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a core hardware product that drives recurring ink sales, and typical industrial product lifecycles run well beyond four years.
Coding on non-absorbent surfaces is a large and persistent market need, so this core inkjet coder and its consumables revenue remain valuable.
The CodeScan app is cheap to maintain and supports the firm's traceability and digitalization strategy, though free apps are sometimes renamed or replaced, which adds some risk.
Inline code verification is central to the serialization and traceability direction the firm is heading toward, and it complements its printers.
The print layout design software supports common operation across the firm's systems, though it could be folded into a broader software suite.
